apps.localizedDescription:
Due to limited RAM, these devices are not compatible. You won’t have access to all the graphic settings and may experience some freezes or crashes: iPhone Xr, iPhone SE Gen 2 (2020), iPad Mini Gen 5, iPad Air Gen 3, iPad Gen 8, iPad Gen 9.

Slime Rancher is the tale of Beatrix LeBeau, a plucky young rancher who sets out for a life a thousand light years away from Earth on the ‘Far, Far Range,’ where she tries her hand at making a living wrangling slimes.

[Explore a vibrant alien world, capture and tend to adorable slimes, and get a once-abandoned ranch back on track!]

*** FEATURES ***

- Play as a curious and adventurous woman trying to get her newly acquired slime ranch back on track.
- Use your trusty vacpack to collect adorab
